parameters.question: Compare A-to-I RNA editing site tables (RNA-Seq pileup filtered against WGS germline variants). Each row must match the reference on genomic coordinates (chromosome, position) and nucleotide counts (A/C/G/T). editing_percentage must be within +/-0.1. confidence_score can differ because scoring formulas vary, but it must be a positive number. The variant_type label can differ (e.g. 'A->G', 'A_to_I') as long as it means A-to-I editing. Column order, row order and header labels can differ.
